about_the_game:
Step into the world of Fantamon, where college orientation feels more like a creature-husbandry adventure than lecture hall drudgery…

You’ve just enrolled at the famed academy of Fantamon, only to discover your first “introductory” lessons involve some weird-looking creatures called Fantamon. No syllabus, no lectures—just a handful of strange bottles and a professor who vanishes faster than your confidence. Now it’s up to you to prove you’ve got what it takes!

Raise & Train

Nurture your Fantamon from catching to raising—feed them, care about them, and harvest their produce.

Build & Craft

Build crafting stations, craft products from Fantamon’s produce, and sell them.

Battle & Triumph

Accept challenges from fellow trainers and locals, then unleash your Fantamon’s skills in turn-based duels.

Explore & Discover

Roam vibrant campus grounds and nearby wilds, uncovering hidden Fantamon species, rare items, and secret questlines.

Are you ready to graduate from rookie to the Fantamon master? Enroll today and let the adventure begin!

The Demo only shows a portion of the storyline, and the in-game playtime will be limited to 3 days only.
